packages.workflow: provider-neutral contracts + Distributed* stores + DistributedQueue (kv-primitive based) + DurableWorker
packages.adapters: Layer-2 infrastructure: Memory/SQLite/Postgres SharedBackend, conformance, retry, phase48 suites

Queue@4.8.signature: enqueue(messageId, payload, opts{tenantId?}) / claim(workerId,max,vt) / ack(messageId,workerId) / retry(messageId,delayMs?) / deadLetter(messageId,reason) / stats()
Queue@4.8.known_gap: message identity globally scoped — tenant isolation CONDITIONAL in 4.8 verdict

queue_implementation_baseline.claim_complexity: O(n) full-list read of 'qvisible' + per-message GET + 2x CAS; cost grows with irrelevant visible messages
queue_implementation_baseline.ack_complexity: get + CAS sentinel + delete inflight/meta + O(n) removeVisible whole-list CAS
queue_implementation_baseline.phase5_target: set-based single-statement claim (FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), composite (tenant_id,message_id) identity structurally enforced by contract

dependency_policy: pinned at frozen sha; upgrades follow upgrade→test→benchmark→failure-suite→acceptance (§34). No blanket bumps during Phase 5.
